name: block
title: world.block
lead: The block there as the handle a hook gets: reads are live, and what it does lands on the next tick. `state` and `data` are for this pack's own blocks. `nil` where that chunk is not in memory.

usedIn.quote: world.block(pos)                          -- the block there as a handle: its state, its data, whether it is powered; see "power"
local door = world.block(vec3(10, 65, 10))   -- the block there, or nil where the chunk is not loaded
